title: The Accident
prompt: A driver causes a serious accident by crashing into a motorbike while turning at a crossroad. When the police arrive, another man is arrested. The one who was driving is taken home.
solution: The driver was taking his driving test and his instructor wrongly told him to turn into a one-way street. The police held the instructor responsible, took him to the station, and took the student, who was having a panic attack, home.
